What is Melatonin?

Melatonin is the primary sleep-regulating hormone

Melatonin, a hormone produced by the human body, plays a crucial role in regulating sleep-wake cycles. Known for its sleep-inducing properties, melatonin helps synchronize the body's circadian rhythm, potentially enhancing sleep quality.

Why Take Melatonin with CBD?

Melatonin and CBD synergize for improved sleep

Pairing CBD with melatonin can amplify their sleep-promoting and relaxation-enhancing effects. This combination may provide a holistic approach to relaxation and rest, supporting the body’s natural sleep cycle and contributing to overall well-being and stress reduction.

What Makes NextEvo Melatonin Better?

Our proprietary SmartSorb™ technology ensures maximum absorption

Our team of scientists and doctors developed SmartSorb™ Technology to make CBD and melatonin work with your body so that more can get absorbed. Better absorption means that you can get more of the benefits without taking more than your body needs.

How Much Melatonin Should I Take?

When starting a Ashwagandha regimen, a good starting dose is Melatonin dosage varies from 2-10mg depending on individual needs and preferences. We recommend starting with a lower dose of melatonin and gradually increasing if necessary.

Our Sleep Support CBD Complex Gummies contain 4mg of melatonin per gummy. If you try one gummy and feel that you require a higher dosage, you can safely increase it to two gummies for the next use.

For our Triple Action Sleep Capsules, each capsule contains 7mg of melatonin, which is considered an adequate dosage.

We always recommend seeking guidance from your physician before starting any new supplement routine. They will be able to provide personalized advice based on your specific needs and health conditions.

settings.title: What is CBD?
settings.text: CBD is the abbreviation for cannabidiol, a natural substance that is one of the most commonly occurring compounds in the Hemp plant. CBD is directly extracted from plants and is 100% natural and has scientifically-backed research has shown that CBD can be beneficial to physical health and mental wellness.

settings.title: Does CBD make you high?
settings.text:
No - CBD will not make you high. This is because CBD is a completely different compound to that of THC (the intoxicating constituent of the cannabis plant). 

Hemp-derived CBD products are non-intoxicating and have zero psychoactive properties. High-quality CBD products can be used safely in your daily routine to support health and promote wellbeing.

settings.title: Is CBD legal?
settings.text:
Yes, CBD products are legal but they must meet regulatory standards. The World Health Organization describes CBD as “generally well tolerated” and as having “a good safety profile”. 

Therefore it is important to only use high-quality CBD products from trusted retailers.
